concept.title: Performing the Data Migration
concept.shortdesc: This page provides instructions for performing a Data Migration from one instance to another using

conbody.p: This page provides instructions for performing a Data Migration from one instance to another using an app created with the Data Migration Wizard. Instructions may vary slightly depending on if any customizations were made to the app outside of the Wizard. For help with specific user actions or action flows, refer to the appropriate section in this guide.
